products.name: zCAD AI
products.tagline: AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes
products.description: zCAD. AI is an AI-native platform for generating parametric 3D models, built for designers, makers and engineers. Describe a part or assembly in plain language, and zCAD. AI generates an editable, dimension-driven 3D model built on real CAD geometry, not a static mesh. • Complete assemblies from a single prompt, with mates between parts • Refine in plain language, or edit dimensions in a browser-based CAD editor • Export to STEP for use in any CAD tool

products.name: myPip
products.tagline: Vibe code, publish, and monetize games with AI
products.description: MyPip turns your game ideas into playable games you can publish and monetize. Describe what you want to build, and AI brings it to life directly in your browser, no coding required. Create multiplayer experiences, add in-app purchases and ads, and take your games beyond the browser to reach more players. From your first idea to publishing and monetization, MyPip gives anyone the tools to become a game creator.

products.name: 1Password for Agents
products.tagline: Let AI agents sign in for you without seeing your passwords
products.description: 1Password for Agents lets supported AI agents sign in to your accounts without ever seeing your passwords. When an agent hits a login, it asks 1Password. You approve or deny on your own device, and 1Password fills the password or one-time code directly. Connecting an agent doesn’t open your whole vault. Included in Individual and Family plans, with Meta Muse and Grok Bot rolling out and a waitlist.

products.name: AgentValley
products.tagline: Every Claude Code agent, at a glance, in your Mac's notch
products.description: It sits in your MacBook's notch. Every Claude Code session gets a card, every sub-agent gets a row, and each one has a little pixel programmer. You see who's working, on which model, and who's waiting on you. Free and open source.

products.name: Canva Craft
products.tagline: Turn prompts into design-ready images you can edit
products.description: Canva Craft is Canva’s first in-house image model, built for marketers, creators and designers who need images that work as designs, not just pictures. Unlike models trained mostly on photos that render pixels straight from a prompt, Craft learned from millions of Canva templates and plans the composition first, then renders it at 2K in 30+ aspect ratios. Expect legible text in 55 languages, precise placement and outputs you can split into editable layers. Live in Canva today, plus API.

products.name: LinkIntel
products.tagline: Post insights delivered direct to your AI
products.description: Your AI already drafts your X posts, but it has never seen how they performed. LinkIntel fixes that. Connect X once and it records how your recent posts do, every day. It also reads X's open-source ranking weights daily and links every change to its GitHub commit. Add one URL to Claude, ChatGPT, or your favorite agent harness and ask for a brief: your next draft starts from what actually worked for you

products.name: Many Displays
products.tagline: Zero clicks: windows back after sleep, unlock or replugging
products.description: Nothing to save, no layouts to name, nothing to click. Many Displays quietly remembers where every window lives (display, position, size) and puts everything back on its own when your Mac wakes, unlocks or reconnects its monitors. Grant Accessibility once and forget it's there. Built for identical monitors that macOS keeps swapping: it tells them apart, even by the port they're plugged into. No cloud, no account. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial.

products.name: Penta
products.tagline: A ’90s 5-disc CD changer on iPhone Duo
products.description: Penta turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a ’90s 5-disc CD changer for your Apple Music library. Every click, whir and tray motor is recorded from a real CD changer. On iPhone Duo the phone is the jewel case: close it and you’re holding the album, open it and the case opens with it, then drop the disc into the carousel. Hold it upright for a CD wallet over the tray that animates open and closed. Free, with an optional one-time Pro unlock for the real printed CD art.

products.name: Byter
products.tagline: Know exactly how much data you use, on every network
products.description: Byter shows how much internet data you use, and where. It tracks usage separately for every Wi‑Fi network, phone hotspot and wired connection, so you know exactly what your hotspot bundle went on. You also get live speed, a one-click speed test, daily-to-yearly charts, and gentle alerts when usage spikes. Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads. Available now for Mac, Windows coming soon, in 11 languages.

products.name: Basedash Scheduled CSV Exports
products.tagline: Ask once. Get a fresh CSV in Slack or email every week.
products.description: Basedash automations can now send CSV exports. Write it into the instructions — "send a CSV of last week's new signups every Monday" — and each run builds the file from your data. In Slack, the CSV is attached in the message's thread; emails and the automation's run history get a Download CSV link. Downloads go through Basedash, so recipients need access to the automation to open them. Ask for it once. Get the CSV every week.

products.name: sideOS.ai
products.tagline: Local AI for dictation, meetings, background tasks and more
products.description: sideOS lives in your Mac’s notch. Hold Control + Option, say what you want, let go! It reads your screen, opens apps, clicks, types and tells you when it’s done. Run it fully offline local models or use your own Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or Grok key.

products.name: River Writer
products.tagline: A quiet Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels
products.description: River Writer is a free Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels. You write plain text (.fountain ormd) and a live preview shows the formatted, print-ready pages beside it: Screenplay, Multi-cam, Stage Play or Manuscript. Git versioning is built in, so you can commit drafts, restore files and try an alternate ending on a branch. Outline, scratchpad and todos live as plain files in your project. No accounts, cloud, telemetry or AI; it makes no network connections. Open source (MIT).

products.name: How It Went
products.tagline: Your route, photos and clips as a short film
products.description: Turns one ride or a whole trip into a short film from the GPS track, photos and clips you already have. Your track draws itself across a tilted map, each photo appears where you took it, and clips play where they were shot. Pick rides from Strava or bring Garmin FIT and GPX files. Several days merge into one film, rest days included. Fix a wrong camera clock once and every shot from it moves. Out comes an MP4, 9:16 or 16:9, assembled and encoded on your iPhone, Android phone or Mac.

products.name: Shedi
products.tagline: Get back the space Xcode, Docker and node_modules ate
products.description: The honest Mac cleaner. Shedi finds what Xcode, Docker, node_modules and 20+ package managers left on your Mac, says what each item is and whether it comes back, and cleans only what you pick. Everything goes to the Trash first. Pay once.
